regime_context: The detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative tape: Coal is the sole eligible leader (rank 1, durability 0.52) with only Banks also eligible, while 20 of 22 themes are ineligible. Crucially, gate_helps is false — the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), so the single validated edge does not hold here; the AI directive permits at most ONE checkable conditional lean, and the track record (dir_accuracy 0.337 over 98 calls) mandates low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.935, currently ineligible) becomes eligible on the next detector update — that would represent a confirmed leadership handoff away from the one-narrative Coal tape, and this watch retires if Gold Miners fail to become eligible within the next two detector prints.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible leader and the one_narrative=true tape is concentrating leadership there; its cross-sectional rank is high and it is not crowded. However, its durability is only mid-range (0.52), its hurst_tag is mean-revert (whipsaw-prone), and the trend gate has no drawdown edge in this market, so this is a stay-with-the-leader lean rather than an edge call.
theses.dissent: Coal's mean-revert signature and only 0.5 breadth suggest leadership is fragile; the tape has historically whipsawed the trend gate, so the leader may reverse without warning and the single-narrative concentration could unwind.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) underperforms CSI 300 by more than 6% from the note date before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only other eligible theme but carry a crowding flag (z=1.83, crowded=true) that the guardrails say should only down-size, not fade. Within a two-eligible-theme universe, the crowding texture argues for relative caution versus Coal rather than an outright negative return forecast.
theses.dissent: Banks have the highest durability (0.83) and full breadth (1.0) in the ranking, suggesting genuine trend health; crowding is a coincident texture, not a forward signal, and the high-durability trend could easily continue.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) outperform Coal (515220.SS) by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
